verdict.rationale: AvaTax exposes transaction records, nexus definitions, and jurisdiction-level tax calculation data via API/MCP, which are building blocks for a liability view, and community evidence confirms tax collection is handled distinctly from filing/remittance workflows. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated 'accrued liability by jurisdiction' report, a collected-vs-owed reconciliation view, or filing-ready/GL-consumable exports. missing for 10: jurisdiction liability summary report, collected-vs-owed reconciliation, filing-ready export formats, GL/accounting-system export integration.
